edits.text: PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant responds to Plaintiff’s First Requests for Production as follows. These responses are based on information presently known and reasonably available to Defendant and are subject to supplementation as required by the applicable rules.
edits.name: Revised preliminary statement

edits.text: 1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to a request only to the extent stated in the specific response to that request. Any objection is limited to the portion of the request to which it applies. Defendant does not waive any applicable privilege or protection by producing non-privileged responsive materials. The following statement is not intended to assert a blanket objection or to replace any request-specific response.
edits.name: Revised general objections

edits.text: 2. PRODUCTION. Subject to and without waiving any specific objections stated in the responses, Defendant will produce non-privileged documents responsive to the requests after a reasonable search. The production will be made in the manner and at the time agreed by the parties or otherwise required by the applicable rules. Any limitations on the scope of a production will be stated in the response to the relevant request.
edits.name: Revised production

edits.text: 3. PRIVILEGE LOG. To the extent Defendant withholds responsive documents on the basis of privilege or work-product protection, Defendant will provide information identifying the withheld materials to the extent required by the applicable rules, unless the parties agree otherwise. No privilege log is represented as attached unless one is in fact served with these responses.
edits.name: Revised privilege-log provision

edits.text: 4. SUPPLEMENTATION. Defendant will supplement or correct these responses as required by the applicable rules. This statement does not reserve any right to withhold information or materials that must be disclosed.
edits.name: Revised supplementation provision
